title: Mirror Symmetry of the Affine Toda Systems
summary: For a complex reductive group $G$, we prove a homological mirror symmetry between the wrapped Fukaya category of the affine Toda system for $G$ and coherent sheaves on the regular centralizer group scheme for the Langlands dual group $G^\vee$. This can be interpreted as a geometric Langlands equivalence for $\mathbb{P}^1$ with mildest wild ramification at $0$ and $\infty$.
